name: Neon Conduit
description: Three cyan chambers are crossed by a continuous blue slowing lane and three vertical blue branches. Twelve red lethal blocks flank the branches. Three yellow ring bouncers start together near the center-right lane and at the lower-right corner of the left chamber; three pink diamond eroders start above the center chamber and inside the right-upper and left-lower chambers. No border patrols. Start at bottom center, use the open outer field to route around the chambers, and reveal 75%.
